# Proven accuracy. Ready for more.

Accuracy based on physics, features based on your needs. Designs, proposals, financing, contracts, drone mapping, home electrification, plan sets... everything you need to close deals and get through permitting faster.

[Schedule a demo](https://aurorasolar.com/public-demo/) [Explore our solutions](https://aurorasolar.com/#solutions)

## Why solar professionals choose Aurora

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Ruler-white.svg)

### Accuracy, not approximations

Aurora's standard-setting production estimates are built on validated physics and real site data, not approximations, so your reps walk in with numbers customers can trust, and sign on.

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Magic-Wand-white.svg)

### Automation across the whole job

Aurora automates across every stage of the job: design, pricing, contracting, and permitting. The manual work disappears at each handoff, not just the first one.

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Lease-white.svg)

### Built around your business

Aurora configures to your pricing, your proposals, your workflows, and your team structure with extensive integrations and controls, so your software fits your business instead of the other way around.

## Residential     Solutions

Aurora’s residential solutions have you covered from first design to signed permit, no matter how big your company is. Click through the tabs to learn more.

## Design Solutions

##### Design Mode

### Design every project right

Aurora models the roof, places panels, runs shading analysis, and generates a code-compliant layout in one session, covering solar, battery storage, and energy optimizations (HVAC, EV Chargers, and more). Whether your team designs manually, accelerates with Aurora AI, or works from a drone-captured roof model, the design is accurate enough to sell and build from.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/design-mode/)**

![3D modeling app screen, editing a house roof with green spheres for trees/landscaping.](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/aur_dm_header_1@2x.png)

##### Aurora AI

### Automate the design process

Aurora AI and other advanced automations generate a roof model and code-compliant panel layout in minutes, automatically handling shading analysis, stringing, and fire pathways. The result is a contract-ready design your rep can take straight into a sales conversation, without waiting on a designer.

**[Learn more](http://aurorasolar.com/design-mode)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/aur_aai_body_b1-2.webp)

##### Expert Design Services

### Scale design capacity without adding headcount

Expert Design Services (EDS) lets you order completed, code-compliant roof models from Aurora’s expert design team on demand. When your own capacity is stretched, submit the project through EDS and get your finished roof model in ~3 hours — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — so your sales volume never outpaces your design output.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/expert-design-services/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/aur_eds_header-1@2x.png)

##### Drone Mapping

### Convert drone data into a design-ready roof model

Fly the site and then upload your drone data directly into Aurora to create accurate drone maps to model against. Bundle your map with an Expert Design Services roof model to get a human-built roof model from your captured data the same day.

**[Learn more](http://aurorasolar.com/design-mode)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-homepage-q42026-drone-mapping-603x458-1-603x458.webp)

## Sales Solutions

##### Sales Mode

### Professional proposals, backed by accurate design

Sales Mode turns your Aurora design into a customized, interactive proposal for solar and electrification upgrades. From adding energy usage to calculating pricing, financing options, and expected savings, your teams have everything they need to sell effectively and build trust with customers, all in one mobile-friendly proposal. Your reps can even design live with the homeowner, with guardrails in place to make sure the design always stays accurate.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/sales-mode/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-603x458.jpg)

##### Financing

### Every financing option, one proposal

Aurora lets you quote any financing you offer in your proposal, whether it’s through one of our many integrations with leading loan and TPO providers or a custom financing option. Your team can present cash, loan, TPO, and prepaid TPO options side-by-side so the customer can choose what’s best for them. All financing is based on industry-leading design accuracy that holds up when the deal reaches the lender.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/financing-integrations/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Aur-PrismSM-Financing-1-603x458.webp)

##### Contract Manager

### Close the deal right from your proposal

Contract Manager generates the contract directly from the final proposal, carrying every term, price, and system spec through automatically. Then it routes the contract to the homeowner through Docusign for e-signature, moving the job from proposal to signed contract without leaving Aurora.

**[Learn more](http://aurorasolar.com/contract-manager/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Aur_CM_Body_B2_Tablet_Mobile-2.webp)

## Post-Sales Solutions

##### Drone Mapping

### True-up with data your team captured

After the close, fly the roof and merge new drone data against the sold design inside Aurora to get the project install-ready. You catch any discrepancies before materials are ordered, not after crews arrive, without putting boots on the roof.

**[Learn more](http://aurorasolar.com/design-mode)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-homepage-q42026-drone-mapping-603x458-1-603x458.webp)

##### Plan Sets and Engineering Stamps

### From design to permit, without leaving Aurora

Aurora offers two paths to permit-ready plan sets and stamps, both right in the platform where the design lives. Instant Plan Sets puts you in control, generating permit documentation from your design in under 60 seconds. Where Instant Plan Sets isn’t available, Plan Sets Service delivers AHJ-ready plan sets in 24-48 hours, with a 95% first-time AHJ approval rate and no outside vendor to manage.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/plan-sets/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-PS-B2-2-1x-603x458.webp)

##### Racking

### Racking integrated from design to order

Aurora’s racking integrations let you design your specific racking system to spec within the platform and generate a complete bill of materials automatically. The bill of materials flows directly to supplier ordering, so what’s designed is what gets ordered, with no manual steps between.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/partners/directory/?filters%5Btypes%5D%5B276%5D=racking-design&filters%5Btypes%5D%5B278%5D=bill-of-materials&filters%5Btypes%5D%5B277%5D=solar-layout)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-HP-racking-2-603x458.webp)

## Enterprise Solutions

##### Team Management

### Built around how your organization runs

Teams lets you mirror your organization’s structure inside Aurora, assigning users to teams and controlling which projects each team can access. Managers can filter and view projects by team, so you know how each office, region, or partner is running, down to the project level.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/aurora-for-channel-managers/)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-HP-Team-Management-2@2x-603x458.webp)

##### Integrations

### One coordinated residential stack

Aurora’s pre-built integrations with leading CRMs, financing platforms, and field operations tools keep your data flowing between systems automatically. Aurora sits at the center of your tech stack and keeps everything in sync.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/partners/directory/?s&filters%5Bcategory%5D%5B257%5D=technology-partner)**

![](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Aur-HP-Integrations@2x-2-603x458.webp)

##### API

### Connect anything your workflows need

The Aurora API connects your CRM, financing platforms, and operations tools to Aurora’s data in real time. Build the integrations your workflow requires, or use Aurora’s pre-built connectors to get up and running faster.

**[Learn more](https://aurorasolar.com/api/)**

![Aerial view of a solar panel layout design overlaid on a residential roof using a computer software interface for optimal placement.](https://aurorasolar.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/aur-api-b2-603x458.png)

See it in action
